package answer

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"golang.org/x/net/html"
)

type htmlElementRule struct {
	Tag                string
	Required           bool
	RequiredAttributes map[string][]string
	RequiredChildren   []htmlElementRule
	TextContainsAny    []string
	MinChildren        int
}

type parsedHTMLDocument struct {
	Path         string
	Doc          *html.Node
	HasDoctype   bool
	ExplicitTags map[string][]map[string]string
}

func validateHTMLDocumentRules(rules map[string]any, requiredFiles []string, fileContents map[string]string) ([]ValidationError, bool, error) {
	if rules == nil {
		return nil, false, nil
	}
	_, hasDoctypeRule := rules["doctype"]
	_, hasHTMLRule := rules["html"]
	_, hasHeadRule := rules["head"]
	_, hasBodyRule := rules["body"]
	if !hasDoctypeRule && !hasHTMLRule && !hasHeadRule && !hasBodyRule {
		return nil, false, nil
	}

	path, content := selectHTMLDocumentForValidation(requiredFiles, fileContents)
	if path == "" {
		return []ValidationError{{
			Code:    "HTML_DOCUMENT_MISSING",
			Message: "HTML document is missing",
			File:    strings.Join(requiredFiles, ","),
		}}, true, nil
	}

	doc, err := parseHTMLDocument(path, content)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, true, err
	}

	errors := make([]ValidationError, 0)
	if required, _ := rules["doctype"].(bool); required && !doc.HasDoctype {
		errors = append(errors, ValidationError{
			Code:    "REQUIRED_DOCTYPE_MISSING",
			Message: "Required doctype is missing",
			File:    doc.Path,
		})
	}

	for _, topLevelTag := range []string{"html", "head", "body"} {
		rawRule, exists := rules[topLevelTag]
		if !exists {
			continue
		}
		rule := extractHTMLElementRule(rawRule, topLevelTag, true)
		errors = append(errors, validateTopLevelHTMLRule(doc, rule)...)
	}

	return errors, true, nil
}

func selectHTMLDocumentForValidation(requiredFiles []string, fileContents map[string]string) (string, string) {
	for _, path := range requiredFiles {
		normalized := normalizePath(path)
		if !isHTMLFilePath(normalized) {
			continue
		}
		if content, exists := fileContents[normalized]; exists {
			return normalized, content
		}
	}
	if content, exists := fileContents["index.html"]; exists {
		return "index.html", content
	}

	htmlPaths := make([]string, 0)
	for path := range fileContents {
		if isHTMLFilePath(path) {
			htmlPaths = append(htmlPaths, path)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(htmlPaths)
	if len(htmlPaths) == 0 {
		return "", ""
	}
	return htmlPaths[0], fileContents[htmlPaths[0]]
}

func parseHTMLDocument(path, content string) (*parsedHTMLDocument, error) {
	tokenizer := html.NewTokenizer(strings.NewReader(content))
	explicitTags := make(map[string][]map[string]string)
	hasDoctype := false

tokenize:
	for {
		switch tokenizer.Next() {
		case html.ErrorToken:
			if err := tokenizer.Err(); err != nil && err != io.EOF {
				return nil, err
			}
			break tokenize
		case html.DoctypeToken:
			hasDoctype = true
		case html.StartTagToken, html.SelfClosingTagToken:
			token := tokenizer.Token()
			tag := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(token.Data))
			if tag == "" {
				continue
			}
			attrs := make(map[string]string, len(token.Attr))
			for _, attr := range token.Attr {
				attrs[strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(attr.Key))] = strings.TrimSpace(attr.Val)
			}
			explicitTags[tag] = append(explicitTags[tag], attrs)
		}
	}

	doc, err := html.Parse(strings.NewReader(content))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &parsedHTMLDocument{
		Path:         path,
		Doc:          doc,
		HasDoctype:   hasDoctype,
		ExplicitTags: explicitTags,
	}, nil
}

func validateTopLevelHTMLRule(doc *parsedHTMLDocument, rule htmlElementRule) []ValidationError {
	if doc == nil || rule.Tag == "" {
		return nil
	}

	explicitAttrs := doc.ExplicitTags[rule.Tag]
	if rule.Required && len(explicitAttrs) == 0 {
		return []ValidationError{{
			Code:    "REQUIRED_TAG_MISSING",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Required tag is missing: %s", rule.Tag),
			File:    doc.Path,
		}}
	}
	if len(rule.RequiredAttributes) > 0 {
		if ok, attrErr := explicitTagAttributesSatisfy(rule.Tag, explicitAttrs, rule.RequiredAttributes, doc.Path); !ok {
			return []ValidationError{attrErr}
		}
	}

	nodes := findHTMLNodesByTag(doc.Doc, rule.Tag)
	if len(nodes) == 0 {
		return []ValidationError{{
			Code:    "REQUIRED_TAG_MISSING",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Required tag is missing: %s", rule.Tag),
			File:    doc.Path,
		}}
	}

	for _, node := range nodes {
		if nodeErrors := validateHTMLElementNode(node, rule, doc.Path); len(nodeErrors) == 0 {
			return nil
		}
	}
	return validateHTMLElementNode(nodes[0], rule, doc.Path)
}

func validateHTMLElementNode(node *html.Node, rule htmlElementRule, path string) []ValidationError {
	if node == nil || node.Type != html.ElementNode || !strings.EqualFold(node.Data, rule.Tag) {
		return []ValidationError{{
			Code:    "REQUIRED_TAG_MISSING",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Required tag is missing: %s", rule.Tag),
			File:    path,
		}}
	}

	errors := make([]ValidationError, 0)
	errors = append(errors, validateHTMLAttributes(node, rule.Tag, rule.RequiredAttributes, path)...)

	if len(rule.TextContainsAny) > 0 && !htmlNodeContainsAnyText(node, rule.TextContainsAny) {
		errors = append(errors, ValidationError{
			Code:    "REQUIRED_TEXT_MISSING",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Required text is missing inside <%s>: %s", rule.Tag, strings.Join(rule.TextContainsAny, ", ")),
			File:    path,
		})
	}

	if rule.MinChildren > 0 {
		if count := countMatchingDirectChildElements(node, rule.RequiredChildren); count < rule.MinChildren {
			errors = append(errors, ValidationError{
				Code:    "REQUIRED_MIN_CHILDREN",
				Message: fmt.Sprintf("Tag <%s> must contain at least %d matching child elements", rule.Tag, rule.MinChildren),
				File:    path,
			})
		}
	}

	if rule.MinChildren > 0 && len(rule.RequiredChildren) > 0 {
		return errors
	}

	for _, childRule := range rule.RequiredChildren {
		candidates := findHTMLDescendantsByTag(node, childRule.Tag)
		if len(candidates) == 0 {
			errors = append(errors, ValidationError{
				Code:    "REQUIRED_CHILD_MISSING",
				Message: fmt.Sprintf("Required child tag is missing inside <%s>: %s", rule.Tag, childRule.Tag),
				File:    path,
			})
			continue
		}

		matched := false
		var candidateErrors []ValidationError
		for _, candidate := range candidates {
			nodeErrors := validateHTMLElementNode(candidate, childRule, path)
			if len(nodeErrors) == 0 {
				matched = true
				break
			}
			if candidateErrors == nil {
				candidateErrors = nodeErrors
			}
		}
		if !matched && len(candidateErrors) > 0 {
			errors = append(errors, candidateErrors...)
		}
	}

	return errors
}

func extractHTMLElementRule(raw any, defaultTag string, defaultRequired bool) htmlElementRule {
	rule := htmlElementRule{
		Tag:                strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(defaultTag)),
		Required:           defaultRequired,
		RequiredAttributes: nil,
		RequiredChildren:   nil,
		TextContainsAny:    nil,
		MinChildren:        0,
	}

	obj, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		return rule
	}

	if tag, ok := obj["tag"].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(tag) != "" {
		rule.Tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
	}
	if required, ok := obj["required"].(bool); ok {
		rule.Required = required
	}
	rule.RequiredAttributes = extractHTMLRequiredAttributes(obj["required_attributes"])
	rule.TextContainsAny = extractRequiredStrings(obj["text_contains_any"])
	rule.MinChildren = extractInt(obj["min_children"])
	rule.RequiredChildren = append(rule.RequiredChildren, extractHTMLChildRules(obj["required_children"])...)
	rule.RequiredChildren = append(rule.RequiredChildren, extractHTMLChildRules(obj["children"])...)
	return rule
}

func extractHTMLChildRules(raw any) []htmlElementRule {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]htmlElementRule, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		rule := extractHTMLElementRule(item, "", true)
		if rule.Tag == "" {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, rule)
	}
	return out
}

func extractHTMLRequiredAttributes(raw any) map[string][]string {
	switch typed := raw.(type) {
	case []any:
		out := make(map[string][]string, len(typed))
		for _, item := range typed {
			name, ok := item.(string)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			trimmed := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(name))
			if trimmed == "" {
				continue
			}
			out[trimmed] = nil
		}
		if len(out) == 0 {
			return nil
		}
		return out
	case map[string]any:
		out := make(map[string][]string, len(typed))
		for rawName, value := range typed {
			name := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawName))
			if name == "" {
				continue
			}
			switch allowed := value.(type) {
			case []any:
				values := make([]string, 0, len(allowed))
				for _, item := range allowed {
					text, ok := item.(string)
					if !ok {
						continue
					}
					text = strings.TrimSpace(text)
					if text == "" {
						continue
					}
					values = append(values, text)
				}
				out[name] = values
			case string:
				trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(allowed)
				if trimmed == "" {
					out[name] = nil
				} else {
					out[name] = []string{trimmed}
				}
			case bool:
				if allowed {
					out[name] = nil
				}
			default:
				out[name] = nil
			}
		}
		if len(out) == 0 {
			return nil
		}
		return out
	default:
		return nil
	}
}

func explicitTagAttributesSatisfy(tag string, variants []map[string]string, required map[string][]string, path string) (bool, ValidationError) {
	if len(required) == 0 {
		return true, ValidationError{}
	}
	if len(variants) == 0 {
		return false, ValidationError{
			Code:    "REQUIRED_TAG_MISSING",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Required tag is missing: %s", tag),
			File:    path,
		}
	}

	var firstErr ValidationError
	for _, attrs := range variants {
		if errs := validateHTMLAttributesMap(tag, attrs, required, path); len(errs) == 0 {
			return true, ValidationError{}
		} else if firstErr.Code == "" {
			firstErr = errs[0]
		}
	}
	return false, firstErr
}

func validateHTMLAttributes(node *html.Node, tag string, required map[string][]string, path string) []ValidationError {
	if len(required) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	attrs := make(map[string]string, len(node.Attr))
	for _, attr := range node.Attr {
		attrs[strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(attr.Key))] = strings.TrimSpace(attr.Val)
	}
	return validateHTMLAttributesMap(tag, attrs, required, path)
}

func validateHTMLAttributesMap(tag string, attrs map[string]string, required map[string][]string, path string) []ValidationError {
	errors := make([]ValidationError, 0)
	for name, allowedValues := range required {
		value, exists := attrs[name]
		if !exists || strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
			errors = append(errors, ValidationError{
				Code:    "REQUIRED_ATTRIBUTE_MISSING",
				Message: fmt.Sprintf("Required attribute is missing on <%s>: %s", tag, name),
				File:    path,
			})
			continue
		}
		if len(allowedValues) > 0 && !matchesAllowedAttributeValue(value, allowedValues) {
			errors = append(errors, ValidationError{
				Code:    "REQUIRED_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_INVALID",
				Message: fmt.Sprintf("Required attribute has invalid value on <%s>: %s", tag, name),
				File:    path,
			})
		}
	}
	return errors
}

func matchesAllowedAttributeValue(actual string, allowed []string) bool {
	for _, candidate := range allowed {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(actual), strings.TrimSpace(candidate)) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func findHTMLNodesByTag(root *html.Node, tag string) []*html.Node {
	out := make([]*html.Node, 0)
	var walk func(*html.Node)
	walk = func(node *html.Node) {
		if node == nil {
			return
		}
		if node.Type == html.ElementNode && strings.EqualFold(node.Data, tag) {
			out = append(out, node)
		}
		for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			walk(child)
		}
	}
	walk(root)
	return out
}

func findHTMLDescendantsByTag(root *html.Node, tag string) []*html.Node {
	out := make([]*html.Node, 0)
	for child := root.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
		out = append(out, findHTMLNodesByTag(child, tag)...)
	}
	return out
}

func htmlNodeContainsAnyText(node *html.Node, options []string) bool {
	text := collapseWhitespace(extractHTMLText(node))
	if text == "" {
		return false
	}
	for _, option := range options {
		if option == "" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(text), strings.ToLower(collapseWhitespace(option))) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func extractHTMLText(node *html.Node) string {
	if node == nil {
		return ""
	}
	if node.Type == html.TextNode {
		return node.Data
	}
	var builder strings.Builder
	for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
		builder.WriteString(extractHTMLText(child))
		builder.WriteString(" ")
	}
	return builder.String()
}

func collapseWhitespace(value string) string {
	return strings.Join(strings.Fields(strings.TrimSpace(value)), " ")
}

func countMatchingDirectChildElements(node *html.Node, childRules []htmlElementRule) int {
	count := 0
	for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
		if child.Type != html.ElementNode {
			continue
		}
		if len(childRules) == 0 {
			count++
			continue
		}
		for _, rule := range childRules {
			if strings.EqualFold(child.Data, rule.Tag) {
				count++
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return count
}
